## 1. Technical Architecture & Tech Stack

### AI Voice Receptionist Engine
- Latency: <800ms human-perceived conversational turnaround
- Voice Models: Neural TTS & real-time conversational streaming (ElevenLabs, Deepgram Nova-2, OpenAI Realtime, Retell AI)
- LLM Reasoning: Gemini 2.5 Flash / GPT-4o fine-tuned on company knowledge bases
- Telephony: Twilio SIP Trunking, SIP interconnect, Call Forwarding, Direct Inward Dialing (DID)
- Capabilities:
  1. Inbound Call Answering 24 hours / 7 days a week
  2. Multi-turn natural dialogue with interruption handling
  3. Real-time calendar lookup and appointment booking via GHL / Google Calendar / Outlook
  4. Instant SMS confirmation dispatched during or immediately after the call
  5. Warm transfer to live human on-call staff for critical emergencies
  6. Automated post-call call recording, transcription, sentiment analysis, and CRM record updates

### Omnichannel Chat & Web Agents
- Frontend: Embedded ultra-fast React widget with streaming responses, suggested quick actions, audio synthesis playback, and multi-language support (English, Spanish, Mandarin, Bengali, Arabic, Russian).
- Backend: Express / Node.js API with server-side proxying and prompt sanitation.
- Conversion Features: Immediate calendar slot picker, contact collection, live SMS notification to business owner.

### CRM & Sales Pipeline Architecture
- Core CRM: GoHighLevel (GHL) Location API v2 with custom workflows and pipelines.
- Multi-Source Webhook Ingestion: Facebook Lead Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, Typeform, Web Audit Forms.
- Speed-to-Lead: Instant SMS + automated AI voice callback within 45 seconds of lead generation.
- Database Reactivation: Algorithmic reactivation campaigns sent via SMS/Email to past customers with customized incentives.

## 2. Service Catalog & Specifications

### 1. 24/7 AI Voice Receptionist
- Replaces or augments front desk receptionists.
- Handles peak call volume spikes with zero hold times.
- Solves the after-hours missed call crisis (78% of customers buy from the first business that responds).

### 2. AI Website & Growth Engine (4–5 Pages)
- Custom designed, high-converting digital presence built on React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite.
- Fully integrated with analytics (GA4, Meta Pixel, GTM DataLayer).
- Complete local SEO schema (LocalBusiness, Organization, Breadcrumbs, Geo Coordinates).

### 3. Speed-to-Lead Follow-Up Engine
- Automated 5-touchpoint sequence across 72 hours.
- Channel matrix: SMS -> AI Call -> Email -> Reminder SMS -> Re-engagement nudge.

### 4. Database Reactivation Campaign
- Segmented reactivation of dormant contact databases.
- Typical benchmark: 8–18% booked appointment conversion from previously dead leads.

### 5. Automated Review Generation & Reputation Engine
- Automated post-appointment SMS triggers with smart review gating.
- Direct 5-star Google Business Profile redirection.
